# Hydromedon — Full LLM Context
 
> Hydromedon is an independent cinematic worship music project by composer Thierry Dubois, published under Soundscape Records, LLC. The debut album Biblical Graffiti (2024) contains 8 original faith-rooted compositions. Sheet music, licensing, and merchandise are available at hydromedon.com.
 
---
 
## About Hydromedon
 
Hydromedon is an independent music project rooted in Christian faith. The composer is Thierry Dubois, operating under the label Soundscape Records, LLC. Music is distributed via DistroKid and available on Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Amazon Music, and all major streaming platforms.
 
The artistic identity of Hydromedon is cinematic, faith-rooted, and mythologically evocative — music for the searching soul. Songs are drawn from the Psalms, Ephesians, Isaiah, Numbers, and Philippians, and written during seasons of loss, spiritual warfare, waiting, and quiet renewal.
 
**Label:** Soundscape Records, LLC
**Website:** https://www.hydromedon.com
**Store:** https://store.hydromedon.com
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/artist/6uDb2bAKe11eYOQR1foFQM

## Album: Biblical Graffiti
 
**Type:** Full-length album
**Released:** 2024
**Label:** Soundscape Records, LLC
**Tracks:** 8 original compositions
**Streaming:** https://open.spotify.com/artist/6uDb2bAKe11eYOQR1foFQM
 
Biblical Graffiti is a debut album weaving together themes of spiritual warfare, transformation, divine protection, and peace. The title reflects the ancient practice of writing faith on the walls of one's life — bold, raw, and unashamed.
 
---
 
## Compositions
 
### 1. Arise, O Lord
**Key:** C# major | **Tempo:** 121 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Intermediate
**Scripture:** Psalm 7, Psalm 35, Psalm 43
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/track/3ut8WjurvXkLDsT24joSSO
**YouTube:** https://youtu.be/YuNm0FGE8AU
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/arise-o-lord
 
A cry for God's intervention, strength, and justice. Born from the psalms of deliverance and the quiet ache of waiting. Carries the tension between vulnerability and boldness — a prayer that rises from the depths and refuses to fall silent.
 
**Lyrics (excerpt):**
Almighty God, my shelter and shield / My defender, my strength in the field / I come not quiet, but bold in my cry / There are battles I can't win, though I try
 
**Chorus:**
Arise, O Lord, scatter my foes / Silence the lies only heaven knows / You are my justice, my refuge, my peace / You speak for me when my words cease / Arise, O Lord, surround me like flame / Let every trial glorify Your name
 
---
 
### 2. Armor of Light
**Key:** Bb major | **Tempo:** 76 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Intermediate
**Scripture:** Ephesians 6:10-18, Romans 13:12, Psalm 91
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/track/03diABBKdeFLKtcF5EDOtb
**YouTube:** https://youtu.be/nlaqCtY2a-c
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/armor-of-light
 
A powerful anthem about spiritual resilience and the strength found in faith, drawn from the imagery of Ephesians 6. Written during a season of spiritual warfare.
 
**Chorus:**
You surround me, Lord, with fire and grace / Angels encamp in every place / Your glory guards me from behind / In Jesus' name, I'm battle-lined / Weapons not of flesh, but mighty still / I stand in faith, I do Your will / Deliverance flows, Your love sets free / Jesus, You fight the war for me
 
---
 
### 3. Beauty for Ashes
**Key:** G major | **Tempo:** 72 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Intermediate
**Scripture:** Isaiah 61:1-3, Joel 2:25
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/track/4BBQAGUamWLmnqZ69ha3ru
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/beauty-for-ashes
 
A song of renewal and hope, drawing from the biblical promise of transformation in Isaiah 61. Written during a season of loss and quiet rebuilding.
 
**Chorus:**
He gives beauty for ashes / Joy for every tear / Garments of praise for sorrow / Peace that draws us near / He heals the soul's affliction / Breaks every heavy chain / His love restores the fallen / And lifts us up again
 
---
 
### 4. Change Me, Mold Me, Make Me New
**Key:** F major | **Tempo:** 68 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Beginner
**Scripture:** Romans 12:2, Jeremiah 18:1-6, Psalm 51
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/track/03eVArWvzKT0agDm8pGhUN
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/change-me-mold-me-make-me-new
 
A heartfelt prayer for personal transformation and spiritual growth, written in a posture of surrender during a season of deep self-examination.
 
**Chorus:**
Change me, mold me, make me new / Into someone who pleases You / Surround me with Your angels' light / Guide me through the darkest night
 
---
 
### 5. Make a Way
**Key:** D major | **Tempo:** 80 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Intermediate
**Scripture:** Isaiah 43:16-19, Romans 8:26, Psalm 40
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/track/3QgZ9UuLlCopfAGoQxWXue
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/make-a-way
 
A song about trusting in God's provision and guidance when the path forward is unclear. Written in a season marked by uncertainty and waiting.
 
**Chorus:**
Make a way where none appears / Grant me grace through pain and tears / Grace to love when hearts feel scarred / Grace to wait when hope is barred
 
---
 
### 6. The Lord Bless You and Keep You
**Key:** E major | **Tempo:** 105 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Beginner
**Scripture:** Numbers 6:24-26
**Spotify:** https://open.spotify.com/track/0dhI4VUj0sj9Dvm4KEjUo5
**YouTube:** https://youtu.be/3bCGi9FL9bE
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/the-lord-bless-you-and-keep-you
**Lead Sheet (available):** https://store.hydromedon.com/products/the-lord-bless-you-and-keep-you-lead-sheet
 
A musical rendering of the Aaronic blessing from Numbers 6 — a benediction of peace, grace, and assurance. Written as a moment of stillness within the album.
 
**Chord progression:** A - E - F#m - B (verse), E - A - E - B (chorus)
 
**Chorus:**
The Lord bless you and keep you / The Lord makes His face shine on you / And be gracious to you / The Lord turn His face toward you and give you peace
 
**Structure:** Verse 1, Chorus, Verse 2, Chorus, Verse 3, Chorus, Verse 4, Chorus, Bridge, Outro
**Bridge:** You guard from shadows I can't see / From dangers known and mystery / You're watching still, You never sleep / The shepherd who defends His sheep
**Outro:** Thank You, Lord (repeated)
 
---
 
### 7. Under Your Wings
**Key:** A major | **Tempo:** 74 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Beginner
**Scripture:** Psalm 91:1-4, Psalm 121
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/under-your-wings
 
A song of refuge and safety, reflecting the biblical image of God as shelter from Psalm 91. Written during a season of anxiety and vulnerability.
 
**Chorus:**
God wants to protect me, this I know / In His peace, I will grow and glow / He surrounds me with His care each day / In His refuge, I will always stay
 
---
 
### 8. Your Peace Surpasses All Understanding
**Key:** G major | **Tempo:** 76 BPM | **Time:** 4/4 | **Difficulty:** Intermediate
**Scripture:** Philippians 4:4-8
**Sheet Music:** https://www.hydromedon.com/sheet-music/your-peace-surpasses-all-understanding
 
A song exploring peace as a guarding presence, drawn from Philippians 4. Written in moments of mental exhaustion and anxiety.
 
**Chorus:**
Oh, Your peace, it surpasses all understanding / Guarding my heart and mind in Christ Jesus / Help me fill my thoughts with what is right / Pure, lovely, admirable in Your sight

## Licensing
 
All Hydromedon music is available for licensing directly from Soundscape Records, LLC. One license covers both sync (composition) and master (recording) rights.
 
**Per-song licenses:**
- Church & Worship: $19.95 — live performance, projection, church recordings, service streaming
- Online Video: $29.95 — YouTube, social media, podcasts, online courses (one channel per license)
- Film, TV & Commercial: $99.95 — feature film, documentary, broadcast TV, commercial advertising, worldwide distribution
 
**Biblical Graffiti album bundles (all 8 songs):**
- Church & Worship Bundle: $99.95
- Online Video Bundle: $149.95
- Film, TV & Commercial Bundle: $499.95
